draft.subject: your dispatch coordinator role
draft.body:
Hi Kirsty,

Saw Northgate has just opened a second warehouse in Leeds and is hiring a dispatch coordinator to enter each job from customer emails. Growth like that tends to multiply the typing.

We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business.

Worth a look?

claims.text: Northgate has just opened a second warehouse in Leeds
is hiring a dispatch coordinator to enter each job from customer emails
We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business

evidence.text: Dispatch Coordinator. Book collections from customer emails and enter each job into our dispatch system.

facts.wording: Built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business (Wish Wheels).
Built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards (MP Online Digital).
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
